lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: At six a.m., we had a van, a key... and a team.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: [scared] No way. Real life has no respawn, no checkpoints, and no mini-map!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [calm] It has snacks.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: [pause] ...I'm in.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: [cheerful] Ding!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [sighs] And a stowaway.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: The closer we got to the Server Farm... the laggier the world became.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: [nervous, whispering] Juno. That cow is... loading.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.text: [cheerful] Don't worry! Betsy hasn't gone over forty miles an hour since nineteen ninety-eight!

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: [deadpan] Did we just... lag backwards?

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: [robotic, glitchy] Recalculating. Recalculating. Re... re... recalculating.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [laughs] Twelve hours left. And we were going backwards.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.text: [serious] The Lag lives in the Core. The very bottom floor. Nobody's been down there in years.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: And when we get there... what's the plan?

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.text: [cheerful] I was hoping you had one. You're the builder.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [deadpan] Great. Great plan, Grandpa.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: We stopped for gas. [pause] The cashier was... buffering.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.text: [polite] One coffee, please.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: [whispering] Is he okay?

lines.speaker: CASHIER
lines.text: [fast, glitchy] That'll-be-two-dollars-have-a-nice-day-have-a-nice-day-have-a-nice-day.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: [whiny, tiny] Are we there yet? [pause] Ding?

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.text: [chuckles, warm] Not yet, little elevator.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: [quiet, surprised] Huh. The graphics out here are... actually really good.
